shots.focal_element: Agent-run spreadsheet columns whose cells flip from a spinner 'Running...' state to a green-check 'Completed' state while text outputs fill the next column
on_screen_text: What is Shopify and who is it for?
How do I get started and how much does it cost?
Target Australia by focusing on mi...
Add FAQs to Low Performing Citations
shots.typography: All text is native product UI: neutral grotesque sans (possibly Inter, low confidence), regular weight body, medium-weight sentence-case column headers with a small type icon, bold question headings in the FAQ document, default tracking; truncated cell text with ellipses.
shots.what_happens: Montage of real product captures under the VO list (w208-w251): a generated Shopify FAQ document scrolls upward, then a crossfade to a wide view of a sheet; the camera pushes in on a 'Regional Analysis (Sheets 2)' agent column where rows resolve from 'Running...' to 'Completed' and 'Market Localization' outputs appear; it reframes to an 'FAQ + Competitor Analysis' / 'LLM Response' area doing the same, then a customer-feedback sheet with company rows completing, a motion-blurred vertical scroll, and finally a fully completed 'Add FAQs to Low Performing Citations' sheet as the VO lands on 'minutes instead of weeks' (w248-w251).
shots.build_rebuild: Build a table component whose status cells start as a spinner plus 'Running...' and, on a staggered random schedule, swap to a green check plus 'Completed' while the adjacent output cell types in truncated text, then animate a CSS scale/translate camera push-in from the full table to the two active columns and blur-crossfade between three such sheets.

shots.focal_element: Presenter seated at a desk, centered, addressing camera
shots.typography: Only physical set branding: a wall screen with a white logomark plus 'Profound University' in a geometric sans and a white desk sign 'Profound' in bold sans; no overlay text.
shots.what_happens: The UI montage blurs out into a medium-wide shot of the presenter in a dark, warmly lit studio set (neon-style lamp, shelves, branded wall screen, desk sign, Shure mic) who says 'And because it's all inside profound,' (w252-w257) with open hand gestures.
shots.build_rebuild: Transition from the last UI frame by animating a gaussian blur up to roughly 30px while crossfading to a locked-off centered presenter clip, so the set reads as a branded studio with the logo screen above the speaker's left shoulder.

shots.focal_element: Presenter's face in a tighter, off-axis angle, placed on the left third
shots.what_happens: Hard cut to a second, closer camera angle from the presenter's left side, with a soft dark background showing the logo object and bust on the shelf, as he finishes the line 'you can measure what actually works.' (w258-w263).
shots.build_rebuild: Cut on the comma between clauses from the wide A-cam to a tighter B-cam angle (subject on the left third, shallow depth of field) to reset attention without any graphic overlay.

shots.focal_element: Agent Analytics dashboard: AI Citations metric card with a line chart, then a 'Platform to Page Journey' Sankey diagram
on_screen_text: Overview Pages Bot Visits Human Visits Google Analytics Logs
shots.typography: Native product UI: neutral sans (possibly Inter, low confidence); small regular-weight sidebar labels with 'Beta'/'Alpha' pill badges, bold sentence-case page titles, large medium-weight metric numerals with smaller green delta values, default tracking.
shots.what_happens: The presenter blurs out into a Sheets list page; the cursor moves down the sidebar and clicks 'Agent Analytics' as the VO says 'Use agent analytics' (w264-w266); the dashboard appears and the camera pushes in on the AI Citations card and its spiking line chart; it then dissolves to a 'Platform to Page Journey' Sankey diagram whose bands flow from AI platforms to pages, the cursor hovers a toggle at top right, and the frame fades lighter toward the next shot on 'stop guessing.' (w286-w287).
shots.build_rebuild: Show a sidebar app frame, animate a cursor to the 'Agent Analytics' nav item and trigger a click state, swap to a dashboard and tween a scale-up push-in centered on the metric card and line chart, then crossfade to an SVG Sankey diagram whose ribbons are revealed left to right.
